title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 630, 636, 645 and 651

data.notes: Current NANPA area-code material establishes 630 (Illinois), 636 (Missouri), 645 (Florida Miami overlay) and 651 (Minnesota) as in-service U.S. geographic NPAs. Each satisfies shard-A rule integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Food Not Bombs Miami current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site advertises recurring Sunday food/resource sharing in Downtown Miami, identifies the chapter as non-hierarchical and decentralized, and publishes public email, Instagram @foodnotbombsmiami and Facebook surfaces.

title: Homestead Food Not Bombs August 2026 current activity

data.notes: Public August 8, 2026 event listing describes Homestead Food Not Bombs as gathering every two weeks for free meal sharing and protest against poverty and hunger through mutual aid at Losner Park in Homestead, Florida.
